kjv: if there come unto your assembly
note: synagoge is the word for a Jewish meeting place; this is the only NT use for a Christian gathering, a clue to the letter's Jewish-Christian setting. The KJV's "assembly" hides it.

mine: faith apart from works is useless
note: TR "nekra" (dead, from 2:17, 26) against "arge" (idle, useless; B, C*), a pun on "erga" (works) that the TR loses.
